user.title: Drevos gateway
user.description: Enter the local Raspberry Pi gateway address and private access token. The token stays in Home Assistant.

data_description.url: Example: http://drevos-pi.local:8756; HTTP is for a trusted LAN only.
data_description.token: The token value from /etc/drevos/gateway.json. Never publish it on GitHub or in chat.

command_busy.message: Another Drevos command is still in progress. This command was not sent. Check the current oven state before trying again.

command_rejected.message: The gateway refused the command because it is busy or a control condition is not met. Check the current oven state before trying again.

command_failed.message: The command failed or its outcome is uncertain. Check the current oven state before trying again; the command is not repeated automatically.
